next_authorized_CPU_work: Inspect bounded public request sources and their published provenance without changing prompts or adding prefixes.
Preserve source URLs/version/content bytes and exact complete accepted-record order, with request-to-original-record mapping.

Choose only a complete source that fits the existing limits: 32 MiB, at most 96 accepted requests, at most 32 per eventual partition and at most 4096 prompt tokens; do not truncate or discard records to meet the gate.
Freeze actual input and provenance bytes, inspect with the original parser, then run the existing raw CPU tokenizer; family and GPU flags remain false until separately verified.
Use genuine published session/document/public-prefix relationships to construct and validate the family closure. Report nonpartitionable or unsupported inputs rather than inventing labels.
Prepare independently justified prospective deadline/SLO declarations before development. An arbitrary value chosen to exceed observed costs is not independent evidence.
Keep GPU children offline and unchanged; future GPU runs consume the frozen input and original source/resource/budget guards.
